tasks.question: The client is not satisfied because…
options: He wanted to get a table near the stage.
He wanted to speak to the manager.
He wanted a table near the window.

tasks.question: The customer wants to buy…
options: Three tickets for a concert on Friday.
Three tickets in the orchestra row.
Three tickets but he's only got 20 dollars.

tasks.question: The speakers decided to get home on foot because…
options: They didn't want to take a taxi, that was too expensive.
They wanted to have a walk on that warm evening.
They could not get a taxi.

tasks.question: The male speaker…
options: Wants to call the police immediately.
Asks the girl to wait for 20 minutes.
Wants to join the party.

tasks.question: The teacher did not let the students draw self-portraits right away because…
options: They had another things to do at the lesson.
The students had to practise drawing first, otherwise, the teacher was afraid that their self-portraits would look like self caricatures.
They had to learn about artists who painted self-portraits.

tasks.question: The girl kept Jack waiting as far as…
options: She was delayed at the customs because of the valuable picture she had bought.
The flight was delayed by 30 minutes.
It took her some time to pack the masterpiece she had bought in Rome.

tasks.question: The female speaker wants to…
options: Paint the walls yellow and keep the old furniture.
Paint the furniture yellow and leave the walls as they are.
Paint the walls yellow and change the furniture.

tasks.question: The man is trying to find a present for his nephew who likes…
options: Playing active games and drawing.
Playing football and tennis.
Watching educational videos.
